thesis: The discussion argues that perfect products can signal the end of a technology's relevance rather than its peak, highlighting a disconnect between rapid technological substance and consumer adoption. It further observes that the AI industry faces a specific challenge where researchers create breakthroughs that fail to cleanly hand off to market-facing product and sales teams.
